# Character room preview backgrounds

ogre-armory-v1.png, wizard-study-v1.png and elf-shrine-v1.png are unchanged copies of the user's supplied room artwork. dragon-lair-darkened-v1.png is the separate center-darkened room revision accepted for preview. Original Desktop files remain untouched. These full-resolution files are sampled on the common 470x200 encounter canvas with nearest-neighbor rendering; approved-v2 character PNGs are drawn at native logical dimensions without modifying their bytes.

Preview: /?preview=rooms&room=dragon (also ogre, wizard, elf), localhost only. Room/pose controls select exact registered art. The preview branch does not read or write localStorage and does not install room art into gameplay encounters. No deployment performed.

APPROVED BASELINE 2026-10-25. User accepted these exact four room images with the approved-v2 characters. catalog.json registers exact file hashes and source dimensions; dist/room-art.js is the shared default registry. Do not modify these PNGs without explicit new instruction. See ROOM_ART.md.
